title: Svartsengi (Sundhnúkur crater row) eruption 20 Nov-8 Dec 2024: SIMULATED fire-fountain heights by fissure segment
centroid_method: 1.5 km SW (bearing 220 deg) of the northern crater at 63.898N 22.356W (IMO VONA 29 Nov 2024), i.e. the mid-point of a 3 km NE-SW fissure from Sylingarfell to Stora-Skogfell; approx. +/-0.005 deg
source: Rhodes et al. (2026) Bull. Volcanol. 88:89, doi:10.1007/s00445-026-02006-3; supplement ESM2
model: model: h(t) = Hmax_seg * (1-exp(-B t)) exp(-C t) / peak, t = seconds since segment opening; rise-decay form of Rhodes et al. (2026) Eq. 2 | B = 0.03806 s^-1, C = 1.0680e-04 s^-1 (refit of Eq. 2 to all 37 segments of the four measured eruptions pooled; A = 0.677); curve peak at 2.6 min after opening | scaled so each segment peaks at its Hmax_seg (the pulse maximum). The fitted mean trend is A x these values. Model calibrated only on the first ~3 h of fountaining; later values are extrapolation. | eruption Hmax = 120 m (first segment), weighted mean of two regressions on the four measured eruptions (Dec 2023 93 m, Jan 2024 56 m, Mar 2024 124 m, Aug 2024 133 m): | H = -56.4 + 58.3 log10(Q_peak) [resid SD 15 m] -> 125 m with Q = 1300 m3/s (1300 m3/s initial effusion rate (IMO)) | H = 46.6 + 18.6 L_fissure_km [resid SD 28 m] -> 103 m with L = 3.0 km | later segments: Hmax_seg = ratio x eruption Hmax, ratio = median of observed (segment max / eruption max) for segments opening <30 min (0.45), 30-120 min (0.39), >120 min (0.14) after onset (Rhodes et al. supplement)

segments.name: middle
segments.basis: initial 2 km fissure; first segment (assumed); middle vent ceased 25 Nov (IMO)

segments.name: south
segments.basis: initial 2 km fissure (+2 min assumed); southern vent active overnight 24-25 Nov, ceased 25 Nov (IMO)

segments.name: north
segments.basis: NE extension 2->3 km over ~2.5 h after onset; opening set to mid-window (23:14-01:44); last activity ~07:00 8 Dec (IMO)
